## Layanan yang Tersedia

| Kategori | Metode |
|----------|--------|
| **Ekonometrika** | Regresi (OLS, Bayes, Panel, Logit/Probit), DiD, Instrumental Variables, VAR/VECM, ARDL, dll. |
| **Statistika** | Uji hipotesis, ANOVA, SEM/PLS, analisis faktor, survey, dll. |
| **Machine Learning** | Random Forest, XGBoost, Neural Networks, Causal ML (DML, Meta-Learners), dll. |
| **Analisis Spasial** | GWR, spatial econometrics (SAR/SEM/SDM), LISA, dll. |
| **Data** | Susenas, Podes, IO, IRIO, IFLS |
| **Tools** | R, Python, STATA, EViews, SPSS |

## Alur Kerja
